{"notes": "Visit 2 (left 2:30). Still can't tell who placed which domino, so physical credit stays unassigned.

Table: the connected chain is now long, running from START down, across and up to about (27,6.7), then hooking down to about (28.3,11). The pale top line has grown to about (20.5,8) but is still NOT connected, with a gap at its base near START (~(6,9.5)). Hana's 2:00 diagnosis was correct. Risk: the whole top line is wasted if the joint isn't fixed. Check the gap first next visit.

Hana: Strongest this visit. She announced the belly done (the chain looks complete and clean, though I can't confirm it's hers). She spotted the unconnected nose, told Sofia and Omar, and took ownership of the joint. Clear, proactive, good collaboration. Caveat: the joint was still open when I left, so verify she actually closes it. She also plans to check the middle.

Omar: Kept laying the top line as asked, and that line grew a lot, but I can't confirm it's his. He only echoed thanks and didn't raise the connection himself. Reliable but passive. Ask him directly how the top line is aligned to the nose.

Sofia: Deferred to Hana and said she'd stay off the joint and check the middle later. That's sensible delegation, but I've now seen no hands-on work or problem-spotting from her; Hana caught the gap, not her. Watch whether she checks the middle when she says she will, and whether she contributes beyond directing.

Jack: Not seen or heard this visit. No tail evidence beyond the hook at the end, which I can't attribute. Still unverified; ask what he's built and whether it's connected."}
